metadata.title: Find worker
metadata.description: Workers who fit your task, best match first.

en.title: Find worker
en.description: Workers who cover this task's area and fit its categories, best match first. Ask one to quote and they decide whether to send a price.
en.left: You can ask {left} more for this task.
en.leftOne: You can ask 1 more for this task.
en.leftNone: You've asked {limit} workers about this task, the most for one task.

empty.title: No matching workers yet
empty.body: Nobody who covers this area fits {categories} right now. You can still ask a worker from their profile.
empty.bodyNoCategories: Nobody who covers this area fits this task right now. You can still ask a worker from their profile.

proRequired.title: Find worker comes with Slashie Pro
proRequired.body: With Slashie Pro you see the workers who fit your task and can ask up to {proLimit} of them.

closed.title: This task isn't open for quotes any more
closed.body: Find worker is for tasks that are open.

unavailable.title: We couldn't open this
unavailable.body: Find worker is for the person who posted the task.

error.title: That didn't load
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

metadata.title: 尋找工作者
metadata.description: 符合你任務的工作者，最合適的排在最前。

zh_hk.title: 尋找工作者
zh_hk.description: 服務範圍涵蓋這項任務、而且符合任務類別的工作者，最合適的排在最前。邀請對方報價後，由對方決定是否報價。
zh_hk.left: 這項任務還可以邀請 {left} 位。
zh_hk.leftOne: 這項任務還可以邀請 1 位。
zh_hk.leftNone: 你已就此任務邀請了 {limit} 位工作者，已達單一任務的上限。

empty.title: 暫時未有符合的工作者
empty.body: 目前沒有服務這個地區又符合「{categories}」的工作者。你仍可在工作者的檔案中邀請對方。
empty.bodyNoCategories: 目前沒有服務這個地區又符合這項任務的工作者。你仍可在工作者的檔案中邀請對方。

proRequired.title: 尋找工作者是 Slashie Pro 的功能
proRequired.body: 使用 Slashie Pro，你可以看到符合任務的工作者，並最多邀請 {proLimit} 位。

closed.title: 此任務已不再接受報價
closed.body: 尋找工作者只適用於開放中的任務。

unavailable.title: 未能開啟此頁
unavailable.body: 尋找工作者只供發布任務的人使用。

error.title: 未能載入
error.body: 請檢查網絡連線後再試。
